label: Radial–angular description of a point
subgoals: Mark the pole O and the polar axis on the plane
Plot (rho,theta) by walking rho out along angle theta
Convert plotted points via x = rho*cos(theta), y = rho*sin(theta)

label: Determining the angle \\(\theta\\)
subgoals: Resolve tan(theta) = y/x into the correct quadrant
Read theta off the plotted point's quadrant
Collapse the plotted origin to rho = 0

label: Non-uniqueness of polar representation
subgoals: Land on the same plotted dot via (rho,theta+2*pi*k)
Canonicalize plotted points to rho >= 0, theta in [0,2*pi)
